checks.requirement: Portable C++23/QML/material resource and Review test build closure
checks.evidence: Top-level latest-Kit C++23 required probe and platform branches apply to the app. FixedTextureData uses public Quick3D, QFile and QtEndian only; QML named type is registered by moc/type registrar with explicit QtQuick3D dependency. CaseMaterials/GlassMaterial aliases live under scene/; all six raw shader snippets and both fixed float textures are in material_assets qrc. No Windows-specific include/link in new product code. MaterialReview/CLI/test are inside YALAHOO_REVIEW; default builds retain only production shaders and reject the Review CLI. No new external library.
checks.limitations: No target compiler/linker or package execution. Full platform integration remains R31/R32.

checks.requirement: Fixed environment and anonymous cover resolution/ownership/endian closure
checks.evidence: QFile resolves only room-pmrem/dfg fixed qrc names; unknown asset, unavailable resource and wrong byte length diagnose before mutation. Little-endian float asset words are decoded for big-endian hosts. CaseMaterials owns and shares one environment and DFG Texture across three shells, rather than reading/uploading a map per shell. Demo PNG URLs are explicit qrc paths independent of cwd/Unicode user directories. Paper scales the same 3.06 square, uses 1/64 contain/transparent margins and half-texel clamp; alpha<.025 is discarded. No real music path, data root, file write or networking in material production code.
checks.limitations: Full cover asynchronous decoding/leases/atlas are R11. Target filesystem/package resolution awaits user checks.

checks.requirement: Linear capture, shader math, handedness and cross-backend target closure
checks.evidence: Original three meshes are unchanged; world/local varying positions use the same node MODEL_MATRIX once, with normals transformed by NORMAL_MATRIX. Right-handed scene/camera remains shared. Native VIEWPROJECTION_MATRIX includes backend clip/Y correction; refracted UV is framebuffer FRAGCOORD plus projected offset, so D3D/Metal/GL origins follow Qt, with no platform hard-coded flip. Opaque background/paper are captured linearly; all glass samplers are excluded from that capture by the documented SCREEN_MIP_TEXTURE rule. Full mip chain bounds come from actual textureSize and clamp both floor/ceil bicubic accesses. Local paper distance follows the material vertex, not screen rectangles. Paper POST_PROCESS replaces accumulated shading with clamped diffuse irradiance, never emission; glass implements source DFG/GGX multiscattering, single-sided refraction/Beer attenuation/clearcoat and source ACES. One final Effect encodes exact sRGB; environment TonemapNone prevents duplicate ACES/gamma. Shared coefficients apply to both themes; no geometry/IOR/color/cover calibration. Six unchanged snippets are baked in public uniform wrappers to SPIR-V/GLSL330/ES300/HLSL50/MSL12 on selected Kit, with source hashes; Windows actual Quick3D generated shaders also compile and render.
checks.limitations: Wrapper qsb generation is static syntax/translation evidence, not target GPU execution or proof of native shader binding. Actual Metal/OpenGL screen origin, mip capture/filter and shader pipeline need user verification. Transparent recursive capture, array sorting and postprocess performance remain R10/R12/R28.

checks.requirement: Product media independence and material/Review teardown
checks.evidence: Material properties consume existing SceneAdapter.detail and explicit warmth/irradiance; no new clock, timer, media object, source replacement, network request or provider result. Production still uses the unique FrameAnimation. Review freezes that clock, publishes independent camera poses on GUI thread and waits for four actual afterRendering frames. Shared atomic render counter outlives callbacks and connection is explicitly disconnected before return. The QML engine owns CaseMaterials, its three surfaces and shared textures through Qt ownership; native scene outlives the engine. Debug separation is reachable through build-gated Review CLI only. No particle/noise input or external process in product.
checks.limitations: Full array/cover ownership and real audio lifecycle remain later rounds. Native target visibility/destruction delivery is unexecuted.

checks.requirement: Frozen source provenance, constrained calibration and Windows GPU acceptance
checks.evidence: Fresh Git archive supplies model/music-model/appearance/theme/cover source and existing locked Three/Vite dependencies. Installed browser isolates local inputs and rejects external HTTP requests; 90 GPU states cover both themes, front/low/oblique cameras, three cover shapes and all/paper/lid/spine/tray. Source effective numbers and independent Three projections are recorded. Windows same client960x720/DPR1, four GPU frames, nonempty foreground, source parameters, <=2px Web projection and SSIM11x11 sigma1.5/MAE/difference products are required. Nine diffuse probes independently assert zero/.25/overbright print behavior. Calibration follows shared-theme current/±10/5/2/1% in source order, at most three sweeps, with fixed geometry/IOR/colors; Qt lamp unit conversion is N/A because no Qt lamps are introduced in R07. All Release regressions and warning-free qmllint must pass, and production Review CLI rejection is tested. Reports distinguish remaining raster/filtered texture differences from hard geometry gates.
checks.limitations: No target screenshots, GPU/audio or package run. Windows evidence does not imply target execution; full dynamic lighting/SSAO/DOF/array/playback gates are later rounds.
